span.p:
Manual count at tank service
the truth, moves it a lot

div.style: color: rgb(4, 52, 44) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Food eaten per fish
always on, detects change
without counting

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Camera count, any vision route
frequent, biased low
moves it a little

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Known events
restock, found death, transfer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bayesian state space model
population as a slowly changing
hidden number, learns an undercount
per vision route from manual counts

around 38, most likely 34 to 43,
trending down
